title: 125 million-year-old dinosaur with never before seen hollow spikes discovered in China
summary: A 125-million-year-old dinosaur just rewrote what we thought we knew about prehistoric life. Scientists in China have uncovered an exceptionally preserved juvenile iguanodontian with fossilized skin so detailed that individual cells are still visible.
